podcast.body: This song served as the theme to the popular CBS television show "The Beverly Hillbillies," which ran from 1962 until 1971. Earl Scruggs noted in a 1979 interview that he believed this theme song introduced bluegrass music to many people not just across the country, but around the world. "I've listened to a story about a man named Jed, a poor mob near Berlickepp his family fed and then one day he was shooting at some food and up through the ground, come a bubble and prove all that is black gold, Texas tea."
